# Sunrise Communication — AI & Autonomous Agent Manifest

> Sunrise Communication is an enterprise and residential security, telecommunications, and structured network infrastructure provider headquartered in Thane (West), Maharashtra, India. Established in 1999, we hold a verified 5.0 / 5.0 Star customer reputation (93+ Google Reviews) and specialize in sales, system integration, turnkey installations, and 24/7 Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) across Thane, Mumbai Suburbs, and Navi Mumbai.

## Core Service Verticals
- **CCTV Surveillance Systems:** High-Definition IP Cameras, ColorVu, Dual-Light Dome/Bullet, Fisheye Panoramic, 4K Network Video Recorders (NVR 4/8/16/32/64 Ch), Housing Society Compound Surveillance, Cloud Remote Monitoring, CCTV AMC.
- **EPABX & Intercom Solutions:** Housing Society Intercom Wiring (20 to 1000+ flats), Corporate IP-PBX & Hybrid EPABX, Multi-line Intercoms, Auto-Attendant, Voice Logging, Intercom Cable Splicing & Maintenance.
- **Biometric & Access Control:** Fingerprint Time-Attendance Terminals, AI Facial Recognition Readers, RFID Card Access, Electromagnetic (EM) Door Locks, Turnstile & Boom Barrier Integration, Payroll Software Sync.
- **Security & Telecom Structured Cabling:** Cat6 PoE Camera Wiring, Housing Society Intercom Multi-Pair Telephone Wiring, Biometrics & EM Lock Low-Voltage Cabling, Video Door Phone (VDP) Wiring, and Security Rack Dressing.

## Service Terms & Maintenance Options
- **Technical Support:** Prompt on-call technician assistance for active AMC clients across Thane & Mumbai MMR.
- **Warranty Policy:** Standard OEM Manufacturer Warranty on authorized hardware (CP Plus, Matrix, Hikvision, Essl).
- **AMC Maintenance:** Flexible Comprehensive (Routine maintenance + component servicing per agreed terms) and Non-Comprehensive (Preventive servicing + troubleshooting) options.
- **Site Consultation:** Technical on-site inspection & customized BOQ design for Housing Societies and Commercial Offices.
- **Notice:** All specifications, response schedules, and service scopes are customized and finalized based on site survey and written agreement.
